sections.heading: Problem — what this week leaves unresolved
lines: Thin, failed Instagram collection leaves no defensible trend call. The only surfaced hashtag, #sandra, has 2 posts and 0 engagement/hour; treat this as a searchable-planning week, not newsjacking.

sections.heading: Solution — the week's rhythm
lines: Mon–Tue: the strongest trend call from this week's data. Scout data from 2026-09-28.
Wed–Thu: the searchable piece — something that answers a question people type, and earns for months rather than days.
Fri: the shareable piece — rides the moment, dies in days, and that is fine as long as it is not the whole week.
Sat–Sun: nothing scheduled. A quiet weekend is a real editorial choice.
